objective: Fix 6 launch blockers: package manifests (BUSL→Apache), stale URLs, config traps (warn on ignored sections), integration tests in CI, remove allow(dead_code), worktree trust boundary docs
scope: src/config/types.rs, homebrew/, scoop/, winget/, .github/workflows/ci.yml, src/lib.rs, SECURITY.md

criteria.label: Package manifests declare Apache-2.0
criteria.check: grep -c 'Apache-2.0' homebrew/niki.rb scoop/niki.json && ! grep -q 'BUSL' homebrew/niki.rb scoop/niki.json

tasks.desc: Add config warning for unknown/ignored sections in NikiConfig::load
Add integration tests step to CI (expand cargo test --lib to cargo test)
Remove #![allow(dead_code)] from src/lib.rs and fix resulting warnings
Add worktree trust boundary documentation to SECURITY.md
Run cargo build + cargo test to verify all changes

context_summary: Goal complete. All 7 tasks done. (1) homebrew/scoop manifests fixed: BUSL-1.1 → Apache-2.0. (2) config trap warnings: NikiConfig::load now warns on unknown sections and notes session/compaction/mcp/permissions are parsed but not wired. (3) CI expanded: cargo test --lib → cargo test (integration tests now run in CI). (4) allow(dead_code) removed from crate root; only targeted allow on unreachable RenderEngine struct. (5) SECURITY.md expanded with trust boundary table and worktree backend security considerations.
